limitations: One global plan/revision is exercised here; four-mode and recalculation checks are separate exact-suite/P2-02 evidence. Synthetic local accounts, sources and target commands only; no live broker or third-party market data validation is represented.
Plans are manual proposals. API/MCP equality and independent financial verification do not authorize order execution.

Runtime privacy checks cover logs, canonical planning bytes, public database rows and retained JSON/log/HTML/text artifacts against the harness's fixed markers. Raw environment values, cookies and credentials are not retained here.

Runtime filesystem secret scans, package-manager probes, image vulnerability scans, browser journeys, full test results and hosted CI are separate evidence records; this summary does not imply they passed.
Original invocation logs and manifests remain local. This portable record retains their hashes and safe selected results, without raw findings or private host paths.
A resumed run, if present, retains earlier nonzero invocation exits instead of relabeling those attempts as successful.

Collection and assertion inspection are not execution. Individual node result fields remain pending because this inventory does not contain per-node execution reports; final requirement acceptance, if explicitly requested, binds the aggregate full gate.
Python assert/raises/fail and JavaScript expect locations are source-hashed; raw assertion values are omitted to avoid duplicating synthetic hostile URLs or oversized payloads.
Hypothesis example counts are reported only from separately observed exact-SHA statistics. Configuration and collection do not establish executed counts.
Service re-instantiation against PostgreSQL is not evidence of seven stopped/restarted containers.
Replay provider data is synthetic. Licensed external data, production origin manifests and credentials remain unavailable; no HTTP reference adapter is implemented.
Raw provider benchmark levels are available; P204 portfolio performance/composite benchmark calculation is not accepted here.
Historical coverage quality and current freshness are distinct; stale replay data can have complete historical coverage.
Shared P2-S14/P2-S36 and later cross-surface scenarios remain pending even when the four local P203 predicates pass.
